title: ampelocissus robinsonii
intro: Ampelocissus robinsonii, commonly known as Indian vine, is a plant species that belongs to the family Vitaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which provide various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, making it useful in treating conditions like fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Ampelocissus robinsonii include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, and its use as a diuretic and expectorant, promoting the relief of respiratory and urinary issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions.
